title: New Zealand Election: The Next PM is Chris Either Way
description: A fast-paced explainer on New Zealand's 2026 election, covering the cost of living crisis, the Christopher Luxon vs Chris Hipkins rematch, the electoral overhang math, and the long wait for special votes.

lines.text: Why is everyone so *tense* out here?
